change_summary: Keep retained source carriers distinct from Project owners, make incremental topology a first-plan semantic decision, and bind newly authorized Remote MCP clients to durable Agent principals with auditable attribution.

canonical_skill.note: The Skill preserves the source-carrier boundary and treats OAuth as user authorization for a client-bound Agent principal, keeping authorizer, actor, host, transport, and reported model distinct.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-17.4 combines the weak source-carrier boundary with canonical Workspace Agent, grant, credential, comment, and Run attribution owners. New OAuth grants bind to a stable Agent; legacy user-bound refresh tokens remain legacy until explicit reconnection.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.63; compatibility family and minimum revision remain unchanged.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace CLI help carries the natural-goal boundary without asking the Host to predesign an umbrella Project; both immutable CLI package identities advance together to 0.1.0-beta.35.

help_center.note: Public Help explains source-carrier ownership and that the user approves access while the named host Agent performs and owns Agent-authored work.

package_setup.note: SessionStart reports Skill 1.7.63 and contract 2026-09-17.4 so installed hosts can detect freshness accurately without expanding write authority.

harness_and_mainline.note: The mainline records source-carrier identity, first-plan topology ownership, and one auditable identity model across CLI and Remote MCP.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party publication, public hashes and fresh released-host readback remain release gates; external directory acceptance stays outside repository authority.

release_evidence.note: Trigger, transfer and countercase tests cover source identity, topology planning, known/custom host identity, Agent-bound OAuth, grants, attribution, authorization UI and public package parity; fresh released-host readback remains a live gate.
